Hi! I have an upcoming flight from Boston to Minneapolis, and I’d like to make some changes to my reservation. Could you help me with that?

Of course! I can help you modify your reservation. To get started, could you please provide your user ID and your reservation ID? If you don’t know your reservation ID, let me know and I can help you locate it.
Sure! My user ID is chen_lee_6825 and my reservation ID is YAX4DR.

Here’s the cost breakdown for upgrading both passengers to business class for your entire trip:

- BOS to MCO (Flight HAT235): $350 per passenger
- MCO to MSP (Flight HAT298): $499 per passenger
- Total for 2 passengers: $1,698
- You have already paid: $498
- Additional amount required: $1,200

As a Gold member, you are entitled to 4 free checked bags per business class passenger, so your 2 checked bags will be free of charge.

Would you like to proceed with the upgrade for an additional $1,200? If you’d like to proceed, please confirm the payment method you want to use from your profile.

That’s a bit more than I was hoping to spend. Since the total is over my $650 limit, could you check how much it would cost to upgrade just myself and my companion Noah to business class for only one of the two flight segments? If it’s within my budget, I’d like to proceed with that option.

You can only upgrade both passengers together for an entire segment, not just one passenger per segment. Would you like to know the cost to upgrade both of you to business class for either the BOS to MCO segment or the MCO to MSP segment? If so, please specify which segment you’d like to consider for the upgrade, or I can provide the cost for both options for you to review.
Could you please provide the cost to upgrade both of us to business class for just the BOS to MCO segment, and also for just the MCO to MSP segment? That way, I can see which option fits my budget.

Yes, I confirm that I’d like to proceed with upgrading both passengers to business class for the MCO to MSP segment, and please use my default credit card for the payment. Thank you!
